title: Exit Plan
content:
# Housing Transition & Financial Settlement Proposal

**Prepared For:** Owner  
**Prepared By:** Owner  
**Date:** November 22, 2026  
**Subject:** Property Exit Strategy, Q1 Bridge Structure, & Tax-Refund Settlement Plan

---

## 1. Executive Summary

Neither of us can sustain the current housing costs long-term, and operating without a firm, documented exit date is unfair to you. The purpose of this proposal is to establish a binding move-out timeline, immediately strip household operations down to bare essentials, and lock in full repayment of our **$[redacted]** balance (plus any agreed Q1 bridge support) out of our February/March 2027 tax refund.

To eliminate guesswork and avoid awkward status check-ins, we have launched an **Accountability Portal**. Two transition paths are detailed below. **Option B (Phased Exit through March 31, 2027) is strongly recommended** because it aligns directly with our late-February/early-March tax refund window—allowing us to repay you in a single lump sum, fund our next down payment (RV/5th wheel, mobile home, land, or rental/house), and execute an orderly, documented move without a mid-winter emergency scramble.

---

## 2. Core Commitments (Effective Immediately Under Either Option)

### Immediate "Bare-Minimum" Lifestyle Reset

- All non-essential belongings are being moved into storage, sold, or donated immediately.
- The house will be stripped down to basic living essentials only, keeping the property clean, uncluttered, and ready for final walkthrough.
- **100% of proceeds** from sold household items go directly into our dedicated moving reserve or toward reducing the **$[redacted]** balance early.

### Tax Refund Payoff Priority

- Our household tax return is filed early each year and typically deposits in late February to early March.
- **First-dollar priority** from this refund is allocated to settling our balance with you in full, with the remaining balance dedicated exclusively to the down payment/move-in costs for our next housing arrangement.

---

## 3. Option Comparison Overview

| Evaluation Criteria | Option A: Hard Exit (Dec 31, 2026) | Option B: Phased Checkpoint Exit (Mar 31, 2027) — **Recommended** |
|---------------------|------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| **Final Move-Out Date** | December 31, 2026 | March 31, 2027 (Hard Stop) |
| **Q1 2027 Financial Support** | $0 (Ends December 31) | Capped Q1 Bridge (Only active if monthly checkpoints pass) |
| **Repayment of $[redacted] Balance** | Paid in full upon Feb/Mar tax refund (or installments if delayed) | Paid in full (plus any Q1 bridge) upon Feb/Mar tax refund |
| **Next Housing Placement** | Unfinalized; forces temporary scramble before refund arrives | Funded directly by remaining Feb/Mar tax refund (5th wheel, mobile home, land, or house) |
| **Accountability & Oversight** | Portal active through Dec 31 | Portal active with formal Dec 31, Jan 31, & Feb 28 Go/No-Go gates |
| **Overall Risk to Both Parties** | High (holiday rush, depleted cash reserves, temporary instability) | Low (structured wind-down backed by near-term lump-sum payoff) |

---

## 4. Recommended Path: Option B — Phased Exit with Monthly Checkpoints (Through March 31, 2027)

Option B treats January through March as a strictly controlled wind-down and staging window, bridge-financed until our tax refund clears in late February or early March.

### Financial Terms (Option B)

- **Existing Balance:** **$[redacted]** accrued through December 31, 2026.
- **Q1 2027 Bridge Support (Jan–Mar):** Up to **$[redacted]/month** (or bare-minimum utility/housing split of **$[redacted]/month**) for January, February, and March—strictly capped and contingent on passing each monthly checkpoint.
- **Settlement Trigger:** Within 48 hours of our tax refund clearing (expected late February – early March 2027), we will pay the **$[redacted]** balance plus any Q1 bridge amount in full, leaving zero ongoing debt between us.
- **Down Payment Allocation:** All remaining tax refund funds go directly toward acquiring and moving into our next residence (5th wheel/camper, mobile home, land, or house—whichever option provides the cleanest, most affordable long-term fit).

### Mandatory Monthly Checkpoints (Go / No-Go Gates)

Progress will be documented with photos and ledger entries on the Transparency Portal prior to each checkpoint date:

#### Checkpoint 1 — December 31, 2026 (Strip-Down Verification)

- Non-essential items moved to storage, sold, or donated; living space reduced to bare essentials.
- Baseline room photos, inventory liquidation log, and **$[redacted]** balance ledger verified by Owner.

#### Checkpoint 2 — January 31, 2027 (Tax Filing & Housing Shortlist)

- Tax return prepared and submitted as soon as IRS e-file opens.
- Top 2–3 housing options (5th wheel, mobile home, land, or rental/purchase) researched, priced, and vetted against expected refund down payment.
- Secondary clear-out and packing completed.

#### Checkpoint 3 — February 28, 2027 (Debt Settlement & Move-In Lock)

- Tax refund received (or IRS deposit date confirmed); full balance repaid to Owner (or scheduled upon deposit).
- Down payment / purchase / lease finalized for next residence; utility shutoff and transfer dates locked in.

#### Final Hard Stop — March 31, 2027 (Exit & Handover)

- Complete physical move-out finished; final cleaning and walkthrough completed.
- Keys handed over on or before March 31, 2027.
- All financial obligations concluded.

> **Accountability Clause:** If documented progress is not posted on the Transparency Portal by any checkpoint date, you retain the right to terminate Option B early and require an immediate exit.

---

## 5. Baseline Alternative: Option A — Hard Exit (December 31, 2026)

If your preference is to end all housing arrangements by year-end regardless of our tax refund timing:

- **Move-Out:** We will vacate the property on or before December 31, 2026, moving belongings into storage and arranging temporary accommodations until our tax refund arrives.
- **Financials:** Your support ends completely on December 31, 2026. Because a rapid December move requires all available cash on hand, the **$[redacted]** balance will be paid in full as soon as our tax refund deposits in late February / early March 2027 (or via **$[redacted]/month** installments starting February 1 if any delay occurs).

---

*This document is maintained in the Transparency Portal. All financial figures and personal identifiers are redacted in the public view. The local admin console holds the full, unredacted version for authorized review.*
